captions.detailed: A compact, square box fan with a matte black outer body casing and curved corners. It features concentric circular grilles on both the front and rear, housing an inner five-blade fan colored in a contrasting light grey. A folding carry handle is attached to the upper rear section, and a small control knob is mounted on the right side of the main body.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact box fan with a square body, a folding rear carry handle, and a right-side selector knob. The fan blade must spin continuously on its central axle, the selector knob should rotate continuously on its side shaft, and the handle should pivot upward on the rear grille frame.
captions.factory: The code constructs a box fan by first modeling a main body using a rounded box with a large central cylinder subtracted to form the fan chamber. It builds front and rear grilles by combining concentric thin rings and radial support bars. The fan blade is created by sweeping or extruding five angled rectangular blades around a central hub. A cylindrical knob is added to the right side, and a folding handle is built from an extruded U-shape profile attached to rear pivot points. These components are organized into four parts (body, blade, handle, knob) connected via continuous and revolute joints.
